blurb: In Sync Dance of Auburn offers dance classes in multiple disciplines and skill levels, including recreational and company dance. Students participate in classes, rehearsals, and performances throughout the year. Company dancers audition and commit to a season with additional expectations and community involvement.
extraNote: No discounts for months with fewer than four classes; no extra fees for months with five classes · Performance fees due 2-3 months prior to performance · Students must call or provide written notice if missing company class after 3:30 pm · Excessive absences may lead to dismissal from company · No parents allowed in classroom; viewing through windows only · Students 5 and under must have parent/guardian present during class
